questions.question: What must a deployment policy specify beyond “INT8 weights”?
options: Activation, accumulator and output formats, scales, calibration and supported kernels.
questions.explanation: Bit width alone is incomplete. Arithmetic, scale metadata, calibration and runtime support determine both behavior and practical benefit.
optionFeedback: Bit width alone is incomplete. Arithmetic, scale metadata, calibration and runtime support determine both behavior and practical benefit.
A filename or container format does not define tensor scales, calibration or accumulation. Write the numerical contract explicitly.
Smaller storage does not guarantee faster execution. Check native operator support, data movement and measured target latency.
